rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a dryly ironic or sardonic remark.

example.english: The boss said the company had no money but bought a new car anyway; that was wry.

rows.note: Use this when the wry quality is understated humor rather than an openly biting or mocking remark.

example.english: After their wry joke, everyone at the table laughed a few seconds later.

rows.note: Use this for a face or body that is physically contorted or turned out of shape.

example.english: Their face was wry with pain.
